title: GTA Online Will Be Supported Beyond GTA 6, PC Becoming More Important
description: Take-Two confirms Rockstar Games will support GTA Online beyond the launch of GTA 6, while PC is becoming increasingly important.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA Online Support Extends Beyond the Launch of GTA 6

The future of Rockstar Games' multiplayer ecosystem has been a major talking point for the gaming community. According to a recent report by IGN Games, Take-Two—the parent company of Rockstar Games—has confirmed that plans are officially in place to continue supporting *GTA Online* "beyond" the release of *Grand Theft Auto 6*.

This confirmation addresses long-running discussions within the community regarding how the transition to the next mainline title will affect the massive, ongoing multiplayer community of *GTA Online*. By keeping the servers active and committing to post-launch support past the release window of *GTA 6*, Rockstar and Take-Two aim to maintain the engagement of the current player base while introducing the next generation of the franchise.

## The Growing Significance of the PC Platform

Alongside the longevity of *GTA Online*, the discourse surrounding platform priorities has also shifted. According to the updates shared via IGN Games, the PC platform is "becoming more and more important" within the broader corporate strategy.

While Rockstar has historically prioritized console launches for its major flagship titles, the expanding reach of the PC gaming market, driven by digital distribution and robust hardware adoption, has made it an indispensable sector. Industry observers note that this heightened focus on PC could signal shifting dynamics in how future software rollouts, technical support, and community ecosystems are managed by the publisher.

## Editor's Take

Deciding to support *GTA Online* past the arrival of *GTA 6* makes strong business and community sense, given its massive active player base. Meanwhile, acknowledging the growing importance of the PC platform is a welcome sign for computer gamers. How Rockstar will juggle live-service support across multiple generations remains an intriguing challenge to watch.
